description: This file contains utility functions for process management, including opening pipes, connecting pipes to standard file descriptors, executing processes, and terminating processes, with detailed error handling and logging.

methods.name: pipes_close
methods.description: Closes all pipe file descriptors if they are open.

methods.name: pipes_close_unneeded
methods.description: Closes specific pipe file descriptors that are not needed after connecting.

methods.name: pipes_open
methods.description: Creates pipes for input, output, and error streams, and assigns their file descriptors.

methods.name: pipes_connect
methods.description: Connects pipes to standard input, output, and error file descriptors using dup2.

methods.name: process_execute
methods.description: Forks and executes a process with specified arguments, setting up pipes for communication.

methods.name: process_terminate
methods.description: Terminates a process by sending SIGTERM and waits for it to exit.
